blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY – Vice Gov. Robert Fernandez and 11 members of the Sanggunian Panlalawigan have resumed their duties after serving their six-month preventive suspension over alleged irregularities in the use of the province’s P30.5-million disaster response fund.
